title: Suspicious Pumpkin
wikitext:
A '''Suspicious Pumpkin''' can be found in the field outside the [[Plump Pumpkin]] in [[Northwind]]. Interacting with it while having [[Perfumed Letter (1)|Perfumed Letter #1]] allows for the acquisition of [[Perfumed Letter (2)|Perfumed Letter #2]].
